role_voices.text_zh: 哦！你來了！太好了～這些給汝！閻皇出去玩了！
role_voices.text_en: Oh! You're here! That's perfect~ These are for you! I'm going out to play!

role_voices.text_zh: 不要再跟小孩子說不聽話會下地獄了！地獄已經滿了！
role_voices.text_en: Stop telling kids that they'll go to Hell if they misbehave! It's already full down there!

role_voices.text_zh: 要是看到地獄的官吏，就說閻皇不在這裡！
role_voices.text_en: If you see the officials of hell, tell them that I'm not here!

role_voices.text_zh: 難得可以偷懶……休息！汝怎麼可以告密！
role_voices.text_en: I got a rare chance to slack off... I mean rest! How could you tell on me!

role_voices.text_zh: 呼……呃、嗯？！閻皇沒有睡著，只是公文太多了！
role_voices.text_en: Phew...uh, hmm?! I didn't fall asleep, it's just that there's too much paperwork!

role_voices.text_zh: 今天的點心是沾滿糖粉跟鮮血的炸蒟蒻條！
role_voices.text_en: Today's dish is konjac jelly fried with sugar and fresh blood!

role_voices.text_zh: 閻皇今天有乖乖工作，該給閻皇一點獎勵了吧？
role_voices.text_en: I've been working hard today, so don't you think I deserve a reward?

role_voices.text_zh: 有美味的肉棒卻不能吃……閻皇已經忍無可忍了！
role_voices.text_en: There is a delicious meat rod but I can't eat it... I can't take it much longer!

role_voices.text_zh: 哼哼～讓閻皇看看汝有什麼能耐！
role_voices.text_en: Hehe~ Show me what you're made of!
Life and death are up to fate!

role_voices.text_zh: 這點小事還要閻皇出馬！
role_voices.text_en: "A small matter like this hardly requires the Styx Emperor herself to step in!"
